bib.title: PaLI: A Jointly-Scaled Multilingual Language-Image Model

read.skipped: reference list (chars 40961-64797) skimmed not read; datasheet table 25 tail after ~105,700 not read

question: Does jointly scaling vision and language components, with multilingual pretraining, improve a unified image+text-to-text model?
hypothesis: Scaling the vision component alongside the language component gives a better return than scaling language alone.
contributions: Simple modular encoder-decoder architecture reusing unimodal checkpoints
Joint scaling of vision and language, ViT-e 4B
Multilingual WebLI (100+ languages) and multilingual model

method.summary: PaLI feeds output patch features of a ViT (no pooling) to an mT5 encoder-decoder, treats every task as image+text prompt to text. Initialised from mT5-L/XXL and ViT-G/ViT-e, pretrained on a 1.6B-example multilingual mix from WebLI, 224x224 with ViT frozen; 17B adds a 10k-step 588x588 phase.
method.task: image+text to text: captioning, VQA, scene-text, zero-shot classification, multilingual

datasets.name: WebLI
datasets.size: 10B images, 12B alt-texts, 29B image-OCR pairs; top 10% (~1B examples) used
datasets.preprocessing: near-dedup against 68 vision/V&L datasets (0.36% removed); cross-modal cosine-similarity filter keeps top 10%

datasets.name: Pretraining mixture
datasets.size: 1.6B examples (Table 9: 100M text-only, 1000M WebLI alt-text, 100M OCR, 100M CC3M-35L, 100M VQA, 100M VQG, 50M OA, 16M detection = 1566M)
datasets.source: WebLI, CC3M-35L, VQ2A-CC3M-35L, Open Images, Visual Genome, Object365

datasets.name: VQAv2, OKVQA, TextVQA, VizWiz-QA, ST-VQA, NoCaps, TextCaps, VizWiz-Cap, Crossmodal-3600, xGQA, MaXM, ImageNet+OOD
datasets.preprocessing: TextCaps/TextVQA/VizWiz/ST-VQA use OCR strings from an external service, ordered top-left to bottom-right

other.resolutions: pretrain 224, then 588 for 10k steps; fine-tune 490 for 3B/15B, 588 for 17B, 378 for xGQA/MaXM, 224 for Crossmodal-3600

models.name: ViT-e
models.architecture: vanilla ViT e/14, width 1792, depth 56, MLP 15360, 16 heads, patch 14

other.inferred_tokens_per_image: inferred: 224/14=16 per side -> 256 tokens; 490/14=35 -> 1225; 588/14=42 -> 1764 (patch 14 from 'e/14', no pooling)

training.objective: teacher-forced softmax cross-entropy over a mixture of 8 tasks (span corruption, split-captioning, captioning, OCR, VQA, VQG, object-aware VQA, detection)
training.regularisation: ViT frozen during 224 pretraining; all params updated in high-res phase
training.hardware: 1,024 TPUv4 chips (224 phase), 512 TPUv4 chips (high-res phase)

other.ViT-e training: JFT-3B, batch 16,384, 224x224, 1M steps, lr 0.0008, inverse sqrt decay, linear cooldown last 100k, two cooldowns (with/without inception crop) weight-averaged
other.fine-tuning: batch 256, linear decay to zero, peak LR 3e-5 to 1e-4, steps 5k-20k (Table 10)
other.high-res: positional embeddings 2D bilinear upsampled, patch size unchanged, mixture reduced to OCR, CC3M-35L, VQ2A equally weighted
other.framework: JAX/Flax, T5X, Flaxformer; ViT-e via big_vision

inference.prompting: text prompt per task e.g. 'Answer in EN: <question>', 'Generate the alt_text in ⟨lang⟩'; zero-shot ImageNet scores 1000 class strings with decoder

metrics.name: VQA accuracy
metrics.definition: exact match of generated text (open vocab)

eval.protocol: single reported runs; no seeds or variance stated

availability.weights: not public ('current version is not available for the public')

prompts.text: Generate alt_text in EN at 2: Photo of ⟨extra_id_0⟩
detect cat and dog and leopard

results.claim: PaLI pretrains at 224x224 and the 17B model adds a short 588x588 phase
results.setup: All PaLI variants, one epoch over 1.6B examples at 224x224; PaLI-17B adds 10k steps (10M examples) at 588x588
results.quote: All PaLI variants are trained for one epoch over the entire pre-training dataset (1.6B) with 224×224 image resolution.

results.claim: High-resolution phase adds average gain over seven V&L benchmarks
results.setup: PaLI-17B, 588x588 phase vs 224 pretraining, average over 7 benchmarks (Fig 2)
results.quote: The high-resolution pre-training phase at 588×588 resolution brings an additional +2.0 points

results.claim: Scaling ViT-G to ViT-e (+2B params, ~13% of model) gives larger average gain than scaling mT5-L to XXL (+12B)
results.setup: Average over seven V&L benchmarks, Fig 2
results.quote: the average performance improvement over all seven benchmarks (additional +3.2) is larger than the one obtained with much larger increases in the capacity of the language model (+3.1) which takes more parameters (+12B)

results.setup: PaLI-17B fine-tuned and evaluated at 588x588, cross-entropy only, no CIDEr optimisation
results.quote: establishes a new high of CIDEr score (Vedantam et al., 2015) at 149.1

results.setup: PaLI-17B at 588x588, exact-match generation over 250k mT5 vocabulary

results.setup: PaLI-17B, TextVQA test; OCR items ordered top-left to bottom-right, strings only
results.note: Same table: TextCaps 135.4 without vs 160.4 with OCR

results.table: Table 17, rows ViT-G and ViT-e, column COCO

results.setup: COCO fine-tune at 224x224; frozen vs fine-tuned ViT in pretraining
Generative scoring of 1000 class-name strings at 224x224, no high-res phase

results.claim: OKVQA accuracy improves with ViT-e: PaLI-17B 64.5 vs PaLI-15B 56.5
PaLI-17B pretrained on 1,024 TPUv4 chips for 7 days, batch 4,096
results.quote: The largest model, PaLI-17B, is pretrained using 1,024 GCP-TPUv4 chips for 7 days.

results.claim: High-res phase cost 512 TPUv4 chips for 3 days
results.quote: This high resolution phase was performed using 512 GCP-TPUv4 chips for an additional 3 days.

results.claim: Visual tokens come from ViT patch features with no pooling; patch size fixed, patch count grows with resolution
results.quote: No pooling is applied to the output of the Vision Transformer before passing the visual tokens to the encoder-decoder model via cross-attention.

results.claim: ViT-e GFLOPs per image grow with resolution: 1980 at 224 vs 5777 at 384

limits: Complex scenes described thinly because source data lacks dense annotations
Multilingual ability lost when fine-tuned on English-only data
Open-vocab exact-match VQA counts paraphrases as wrong
Without OCR input PaLI is weaker on text-in-image tasks (TextVQA 58.80 vs 73.06)
Resolution effect not isolated: high-res phase also changes mixture and unfreezes ViT
